caption: Measurement audit: grouped cross-validated prediction of the laboratory analytes from image features. 3 × 5-fold, folds are grouped by sample.

Within-band response: Spearman |ρ| between albumin-image features and log₁₀ laboratory albumin inside each albumin band; the permutation null (95th percentile of the maximum |ρ| over all features when the target is shuffled) shows what the best feature would reach by chance.
Reliability (ICC) before the filter and illumination sensitivity after the filter, by image source.

Error budget: macro-F1 obtained when an analyte is replaced by its laboratory value (oracle rows) versus predicted from images (Random Forest regressors, grouped cross-validation). Oracle rows are upper bounds, not achievable results.
Significance test results for all features (sample level, descriptive): ANOVA, Kruskal–Wallis (q-FDR), ε², ordinal Spearman, mutual information, pairwise tests (Holm).
The 20 features with the highest composite rank and their significance statistics (all samples, descriptive).
Cross-validated macro-F1 per model for different numbers of selected features k (default hyperparameters).
The five competing models and their tuning grids (identical in the nested CV and the final fit).

Nested cross-validation, TEST level (one image pair = one measurement): mean ± SD over 10 outer folds (5 folds × 2 repeats). Chance level of macro-F1 ≈ 0.33 (the majority-class baseline is lower). PRIMARY RESULT.
Nested cross-validation, SAMPLE level (repeat probabilities averaged before the decision): mean ± SD over 10 outer folds. SECONDARY RESULT.

Pairwise comparison of the five models by per-outer-fold macro-F1 (test level): Wilcoxon signed-rank and Nadeau–Bengio corrected resampled t-test, each Holm-corrected over the 10 pairs. Friedman χ² = 10.24, p = 0.0366. Folds overlap, so the p-values are indicative.
Mean rank of each model over the outer folds (Friedman ranking) with the spread of fold-wise macro-F1.
Pooled out-of-fold precision, recall and F1 per class (nested CV repeat 1, test level).
Pooled out-of-fold macro-F1 (nested CV repeat 1) with 95% cluster-bootstrap confidence intervals (1000 resamples of samples) — the uncertainty due to the small number of samples.
Stability of the tuned configuration over the 10 outer folds (chosen k, most frequent hyperparameter set) and the optimism of the inner-CV score relative to the outer-fold score.
Sensitivity of the nested-CV estimate of SVM (RBF) to the random division into folds: 5 additional 5-fold nested CVs with different split seeds, and the two repeats of the main run.

Ablation with the configuration of SVM (RBF) (k = 10; sample-grouped 5-fold × 3 cross-validation, identical folds for all subsets). Not directly comparable with the nested-CV estimate (different splits, no re-tuning); compare rows with each other.
Feature-selection stability of SVM (RBF): proportion of the 10 outer folds in which the feature was selected (the k and the features are those of the tuned model of each fold).
Stability of the selected feature sets for the five models (over the 10 outer folds).

Permutation importance of the selected features of SVM (RBF) on the test part of each of the 5 grouped folds (drop of macro-F1 when a feature is shuffled; 30 shuffles), averaged over the folds in which the feature was selected.
Samples misclassified by SVM (RBF) (nested-CV OOF repeat 1, sample level); sorted by how close the UACR is to the nearest threshold (30 or 300 mg/g).

Error rate of SVM (RBF) (sample level, OOF repeat 1) by the distance of the laboratory UACR to the nearest class threshold; errors concentrated near thresholds indicate label ambiguity rather than model failure.

The uncertain-result ("UNCERTAIN") thresholds stored in the deployment bundle and what they do to coverage and performance (SVM (RBF), OOF repeat 1). EXPLORATORY: confirm on independent data before use.

Final training of the five models on all samples (GridSearchCV, sample-grouped 3-fold, macro-F1). The inner-CV score is the tuning score and is optimistic; the honest estimate is the outer-fold macro-F1 of Stage 13 (last numeric column).
The 10 features used by the deployed model (SVM (RBF)), with descriptive significance (all samples), how often they were chosen in the nested-CV folds, and permutation importance.

Self-test of the deployment bundle on six image pairs: probabilities recomputed from the images by the bundle (in this process and in a clean Python process that has only the three bundle files) versus the probabilities from the training feature matrix.
List of figures produced by the notebook (for manuscript numbering).
